correctness.rationale: For a fixed d-dimensional density matrix rho and independent Haar-uniform diagonal phases, let P=Tr rho^2>0 and S=sum_i rho_ii^2. Expanding Tr(Re(UrhoU*)^2)=(P+Tr(rho_theta rho_theta^T))/2 and balancing torus characters gives mean (P+S)/(2P), variance sum_{i<j}|rho_ij|^4/(2P^2), and central third moment 3 sum_{i<j<k} Re(rho_ij^2 rho_jk^2 rho_ki^2)/(2P^3). Balanced ordered pairs are reverse edges and balanced ordered triples are directed triangles, with combinatorial factor 12. The d=2 sum is empty. For all d>=3, rho=I/d+epsilon H with 0<epsilon<1/(2d) and three nonzero edges yields strict positive definiteness, fixed diagonals/entry magnitudes and opposite cubic signs as the triangular phase flips. Independently formed Re(UrhoU*) matrices over 343 seventh-root grids for two qutrit witnesses and matched mean, variance and third moment at 1e-12 tolerance. The character proof, not finite grids, covers arbitrary d and continuously uniform phase.
